# bwip-js 4.11.4

Browser bundle from the pinned npm package `bwip-js@4.11.4`, downloaded with
registry SHA-512 integrity verification. Upstream: https://github.com/metafloor/bwip-js.
MIT and bundled component notices are retained alongside this file.

Used locally for plain ECC200 Data Matrix containing the exact NP/SKU, not GS1
DataMatrix. No product data is sent to an external barcode service.
